description: Split South Korean addresses into province/city (시도, normalized to the official name such as 서울특별시), district (시군구, including 일반구 like 수원시 영통구), base address (road name + building number) and detail (unit). Handles leading postal codes and addresses written without spaces. Rule-based; does not look up a database.
name: kr_address_split
title: Split Korean addresses
